newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Seven Palestinians dead in West Bank bloodshed.
newsitem.headline: Seven Palestinians dead in West Bank bloodshed.

text.p: Israeli troops killed seven Palestinians in Ramallah on Wednesday, during the bloodiest clashes in the West Bank since PLO rule began two years ago, a senior PLO official said.
"We have seven martyrs in Ramallah," the official told Reuters. He said the total included several Palestinians who had died of their wounds in hospital.

Doctors said more than 300 were injured and they expected The fighting erupted during widespread Palestinian protests against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's decison to open a tunnel in Jerusalem near Islam's third holiest shrine.

At the PLO-ruled enclave of Ramallah, Palestinians pelted Israeli soldiers with stones and bottles. Soldiers responded with live ammunition and Palestinian police soon joined the fray, fighting running gun battles with Israelis, witnesses said.
Gun battles between Israeli and Palestinian forces also erupted near Bethlehem, south of Jerusalem, witnesses said.
